messages.detail: Next decision: protect recovery by keeping utility reserve at or above 15%, or invest in a park or emergency service. Consequence: Emergency repairs cost $2,000, happiness fell 3 points, and weathered 3 completed homes at blocks 4, 11; 7, 11; 10, 11. Diagnosis: 28% utility reserve, 1 park, and 0 emergency services limited average damage to 29%. Objective: keep utilities fully covered with at least 15% reserve while parks and emergency services accelerate Residential repairs until all recorded storm damage clears.
